title: MZ How to work VisuStella Encounter Effects

posts.author: Mountainy
posts.body: I have the plug in in my project already, but since it's my first plug in I'm not sure how to make it work. I'm trying to create an npc that has a movement route, then approaches the player once they're spotted. My main mixup is whether or not I'm supposed to use 'Plugin Command" or scripting when eventing, and how I have the plugin correlate with the movement route. Any help is appreciated, I tried several youtube videos, read the entire help tab that came with the plugin, as well as the store's listing, and am still confused.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body: Don't have the plugin myself, but reading through the wiki of the plugin, it should just work if you put <alert> in the note field of the event (npc) in question.

posts.author: Crim_T
posts.body:
Here's an example on how I set up one of my Monster encounter events:
Some points to note:
1.   I chose to put the Notetags under the comment heading for easier readability,      however you can also put them under the "Note:" heading in the upper left.  For future knowledge, the Visustella plugin wiki will tell you in what locations the Notetags can go.
2.  Take special note of the Event priority and Trigger settings if you want the Event to be able to initiate the combat upon touching the Player Sprite.
3.  You asked about setting the movement route.  To the right of the image, under "Autonomous Movement" set the type to "Custom" and set the "Route...".
4.You can ignore the contents for the Plugin commands and IF statements for setting the Queue if you aren't using the surprise and preemptive attack functions.
Hopefully this helps, good luck!
